_**User**_

Review the VS Code extension at C:\Users\pho\repos\VSCode Extensions\vscode-jupyter-cell-tags for editor performance and stability risks (UI freezes, event storms, memory leaks, expensive sync work on notebook change).

Focus on:
1. Event listeners: onDidChangeNotebookDocument, onDidChangeActiveNotebookEditor, onDidChangeNotebookEditorSelection, onDidChangeTextDocument, file system watchers, intervals/timeouts
2. Tree data providers that rebuild on every change
3. Decorations / status bar / scrollbar updates
4. src/notebookFilter/**, src/customOutline/**, src/outlineSync/**, src/cellExecution/**, src/noteAllTags/**, src/gitDiff/**, src/dependencyChain/**, src/cellHistory/**, src/statusBar.ts, src/extension.ts updateContext
5. Missing debounce/throttle, missing dispose of disposables, synchronous heavy work on hot paths
6. Infinite update loops (selection sync <-> notebook selection)

For each finding return severity, file/function, risk description, and evidence. Rank by likelihood of real user impact. Do not modify files.

## Performance / stability review (ranked by likely user impact)

No `onDidChangeTextDocument` or `createFileSystemWatcher` usage found. Hot paths are concentrated on `onDidChangeNotebookDocument`, selection events, visible-editor/scroll events, and a few intervals.

---

### 1. Critical — Per-keystroke metadata writes cascade all listeners
**Severity:** Critical  
**File/function:** `src/cellHistory/cellHistoryTracking.ts` → `trackCellHistory` → `updateCellMetadata`  
**Risk:** Every cell content change writes `cellEdited` via `WorkspaceEdit` / `applyEdit`. That dirty-marks the notebook, hits the undo stack, and re-fires `onDidChangeNotebookDocument` for every other module (tags tree, scrollbar decorators, filter reapply, git-diff refresh, executed-cells view, jumpbacks, custom outline). Typing in large notebooks can feel like freezes.  
**Evidence:**
```31:39:src/cellHistory/cellHistoryTracking.ts

```
No debounce; metadata path avoids infinite self-reentry (`change.document` only), but the cross-feature cascade remains.

**Risk:** Document changes schedule `reapply` after 150ms. `apply` collapses/expands cells (metadata changes), which fire more notebook-change events. `applying` only short-circuits while `apply` is in flight; timers scheduled during apply still fire afterward → repeated full collapse/expand + decorator/status updates → UI churn / freeze with filter on.

**File/function:** `src/statusBar.ts` `update`; `src/extension.ts` `updateContext`; `src/util/logging.ts` `log`  
**Risk:** Cell selection (and text selection for context) synchronously updates status bar text and multiple `setContext` commands. Status bar always calls `log()`; `log` always `appendLine`s to the output channel (even when `debugPrint` is false). Rapid multi-select / shift-select can stack UI + channel I/O.

### 11. Medium — Filter / git scrollbar work on visible-editor storms
**Severity:** Medium  
**File/function:** `src/notebookFilter/filterDecorators.ts`; `src/gitDiff/gitDiffProvider.ts` `GitDiffCellHighlighter`  
**Risk:** Undebounced `onDidChangeVisibleTextEditors` clears/reapplies decorations across visible editors while scrolling. Lower cost than tag scrollbar full rescan, but stacks with other decoration systems.  
**Evidence:** `FilterScrollbarDecorators` constructor listener; `GitDiffCellHighlighter.activate` scroll listener (git path has a 200ms delay only for active-editor change).

### 12. Low-Medium — Dispose / lifecycle gaps
**Severity:** Low-Medium  
**Files:** `extension.ts` (context listeners); `AllTagsTreeDataProvider` (never disposed); `UpdateCoordinator` (`treeView.onDidChangeVisibility` not disposed); `ExecutedCellsTreeDataProvider` timers uncleared on deactivate  
**Risk:** Mostly deactivate hygiene; timers/listeners can briefly outlive deactivation in reload scenarios.

---

### Modules checked with lower hot-path risk
| Area | Notes |
|------|--------|
| `outlineSync/**` | Debounced; manual selection sync skipped — good loop guard |
| `customOutline/UpdateCoordinator` | Debounced + skips work when view hidden — good |
| `dependencyChain/**` | Command-driven analyze; only light refresh on editor switch |
| `gitDiff` highlighter | Command-driven compare; scroll restore is lighter than modified-cells LCS refresh |
| `statusBar.ts` | Cheap string work; cost is frequency + logging |
| Intervals | Tags hot-color 15min (fine); durable kernel poll separate; JE 200ms poll is the bad one |

---

### Suggested fix priority (no code changed)
1. Debounce/coalesce `cellEdited` writes (or stop writing on every keystroke).  
2. Ignore filter `reapply` for metadata-only / self-induced collapse events; keep `applying` until post-apply events settle.  
3. Debounce tags `updateTags` + scrollbar `updateAllDecorations`; throttle scroll decoration passes.  
4. Gate git HEAD refresh to content changes or longer idle debounce; avoid LCS on output-only events.  
5. Remove/guard execution toasts; coalesce executed-cells timeouts; stop unconditional `log` on status-bar selection path.
